question: How many movies are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM movies;

question: What are the top 5 highest-grossing movies?
gold_sql: SELECT title, revenue FROM movies ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which movie has the highest budget?
gold_sql: SELECT title, budget FROM movies ORDER BY budget DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average vote average across all movies?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(vote_average) AS avg_vote_average FROM movies;

question: How many movies were released in 2015?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM movies WHERE release_date LIKE '2015%';

question: What is the total revenue generated by all movies?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM movies;

question: Which director has directed the most movies?
gold_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(m.id) AS movie_count FROM directors d JOIN movies m ON d.id = m.director_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What are the top 10 most popular movies?
gold_sql: SELECT title, popularity FROM movies ORDER BY popularity DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What is the total budget spent per year?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM release_date::DATE)::INTEGER AS year, SUM(budget) AS total_budget FROM movies GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question: Which movies have a vote average greater than 8?
gold_sql: SELECT title, vote_average FROM movies WHERE vote_average > 8 ORDER BY vote_average DESC;

question: What is the average budget of movies released in 2015?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(budget) AS avg_budget FROM movies WHERE release_date LIKE '2015%';

question: List all directors and the number of movies they have directed.
gold_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(m.id) AS movie_count FROM directors d JOIN movies m ON d.id = m.director_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY movie_count DESC;

question: Which movie has the highest vote count?
gold_sql: SELECT title, vote_count FROM movies ORDER BY vote_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the profit (revenue minus budget) for each movie, ordered by profit descending?
gold_sql: SELECT title, (revenue - budget) AS profit FROM movies ORDER BY profit DESC;

question: Which director directed the highest-grossing movie for each year?
gold_sql: SELECT year, title, director_name, revenue FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.release_date::DATE)::INTEGER AS year, m.title, d.name AS director_name, m.revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.release_date::DATE) ORDER BY m.revenue DESC) AS rn FROM movies m JOIN directors d ON m.director_id = d.id) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY year;

question: How many movies were released each year?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM release_date::DATE)::INTEGER AS year, COUNT(*) AS movie_count FROM movies GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question: What is the average popularity of movies for each director?
gold_sql: SELECT d.name, AVG(m.popularity) AS avg_popularity FROM directors d JOIN movies m ON d.id = m.director_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY avg_popularity DESC;

question: Which movies had a higher revenue than their budget (i.e., were profitable)?
gold_sql: SELECT title, budget, revenue, (revenue - budget) AS profit FROM movies WHERE revenue > budget ORDER BY profit DESC;

question: What are the top 5 movies with the most votes?
gold_sql: SELECT title, vote_count FROM movies ORDER BY vote_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the highest-rated movie for each director?
gold_sql: SELECT director_name, title, vote_average FROM (SELECT d.name AS director_name, m.title, m.vote_average, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.id ORDER BY m.vote_average DESC) AS rn FROM directors d JOIN movies m ON d.id = m.director_id) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY vote_average DESC;
